policymemo.ai for Microsoft 365 Copilot, beta 0.2.0

Full steps, with copy buttons and help if something goes wrong:
https://policymemo.ai/install/#copilot

In short:
1. In Copilot Chat, click Create agent. When it opens a chat called
   Message agent builder, press Skip.
2. Open "1 Paste into Instructions.txt", select everything, copy it, and paste it
   into the Instructions box.
3. Under Skills, upload each of the 8 zip files in the "2 Upload these 8 skills"
   folder, one at a time. Do not unzip them and do not rename them.
   No Skills option? Under Knowledge, upload the 10 files in
   "3 No Skills option - upload these as knowledge instead" instead. No upload option at all? Skip this step.
4. Click Create.

Cannot upload the files? You may be looking inside the zip without having
extracted it. Close this. On Windows, right-click the zip and choose
Extract All. On a Mac, double-click the zip. Then use the folder that appears.

Built 2026-10-04 from house-rules e59f06f77357.
